title: New Canva to Meta Ads Feature
description: New Canva to Meta Ads Feature
transcript: You can now literally import your Canva ad straight into meta in one click. No more downloading, reuploading, or resizing your creatives. Here's how you can do it. Step one in Canva, finish designing your ad, video or image. Step 2 you'll click share and then Meta Ads Manager. Step 3 connect your Facebook account and choose the ad account you want to send this to. Step 4 you'll pick your campaign or create a new one and select your placement. And step No. 5 you just click publish to meta and boom, you're done. Your ad goes directly into Ads Manager ready to launch. This saves you hundreds of hours when you're testing creatives, especially if you're dropping 10+ new ad variants every single week. Comment update and I'll send you the full strategy on how.
